task_definition.task_description: Please check whether the black Sony XM5 is in stock, then place a hold for 1 unit for my account and confirm the order. After that, generate an invoice for 1 unit and send it to buyer@example.com with PayPal, then also check the latest business news, get the current New York weather and any weather alert card there, archive that alert as a medium-priority email note titled “Post-purchase weather archive” for my account, and finally create a document titled “Order and invoice audit note” tagged shopping, invoice, and weather.

user_input.query: Please check whether the black Sony XM5 in the electronics category is in stock for product_id p_sony_xm5_blk.
